messages:
maria: Cooking up a tiny "goal elevator" + 24h calibration loop — one paragraph per goal plus 3 quick calibration checks. Aim: write in <90s and get useful manager/peer signal.

maria: GOAL ELEVATOR (pasteable):
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q4 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 sentence): [the one-line outcome]
Why it matters: [1 sentence customer/biz impact]
Top KR (metric + target) + confidence 0-10: [KR1] (conf 7)
1-line plan: [3 actions comma-separated] (est effort S/M/L)
Key blocker: [person/system]
One-line ask: [what I need from manager this sprint]

devin: clean. Can we add a 3-question calibration DM that peers can answer in a single line? makes responses easier.

maria: yes — CALIBRATION DM (send to 3 peers):
 - Biggest risk? (one word)
 - Too ambitious? (yes/no)
 - One tweak in 1 line

sam: add micro-replies so people can copy-paste:
 - "Risk: data; Ambitious: yes; Tweak: drop action 3"
 - "Risk: infra; Ambitious: no; Tweak: add metric milestone"

maria: also added 2-line self-review hint for the cycle: for each KR, 1 line "what changed" + 1 line "measured evidence/link". Keep it crisp.

people-ops-bot: Template uploaded -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/elevator. Auto-DM button scheduled for rollout. :rocket:

devin: tiny ops checklist: add 2 role examples (SWE & PM), default conf=6, and include a hiring prompt if headcount is a blocker.

maria: will post examples tonight and run a 10-min sync with managers tomorrow. thanks all! :tada:
